newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences Corp Q2 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences Corp Q2 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Latest quarter and nine months includes a nonrecurring charge of $48,929,000, representing costs and expenses related to the August 1 acquisition of Continuum Co Inc The amount of the charge, net of income tax benefits on the tax deductible portion, is $35.3 million, or $0.45 per share, and falls within the previously announced range of estimates for transaction expenses, costs associated with elimination of redundant functions and the write-off of assets impaired due to merger-related business realignment.
Per share income in the latest second quarter was $0.63 before merger costs.
